items.t: Brake fluid reservoir cap can let air in
items.job: Replace brake fluid reservoir cap and bleed brakes
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Fuel vapor nozzle can break in a frontal crash
items.job: Replace or modify fuel vapor vent nozzle
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Rear child safety lock can release on its own
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Climate control temperature acts erratically
items.note: Re-soldering the old control board can cost less if a shop offers it.

items.t: Evaporative emissions leak code
items.job: Smoke-test EVAP system and replace purge valve
items.note: If the charcoal canister must be replaced, expect more.

items.t: Crankshaft pulley can separate and drop the power steering belt
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Brake master cylinder seal can leak
items.job: Replace brake master cylinder and bleed brakes
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Console carpet cover can interfere with the gas pedal
items.job: Trim and secure console carpet near pedal
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: VVT-i oil hose can leak
items.job: Replace rubber VVT-i oil hose with updated metal line
items.note: Often free under a Toyota campaign. Check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if the engine ran low on oil.

items.t: Engine oil cooler pipe leaks
items.note: Toyota's ZE2 coverage may have ended; ask a dealer. Cost rises if the oil cooler also needs replacing.

items.t: Ignition coil misfires
items.note: Price is per coil. Rear-bank coils take longer to reach. Many owners replace all six.

items.t: Starts in Neutral but not in Park
Idle control code from the throttle body
items.note: Check for intake leaks and try cleaning first; that may fix it for much less.

items.t: Driver's power window switch can overheat
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Driver airbag spiral cable can break
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Seat belt pretensioner may fire unexpectedly
items.job: Replace airbag sensor and pretensioner as needed
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Hybrid coolant hoses can rub on the steering shaft
items.job: Reroute or replace hybrid coolant hoses and clamp them
items.note: Covered by Toyota campaign E0P. Check your VIN with a dealer.

items.t: Check-engine light with engine-off timer code
items.note: Often free while under warranty.

items.t: Power liftgate stops or will not open
items.job: Reprogram power liftgate controller per bulletin
items.note: If a liftgate motor or strut has failed, parts cost much more.

items.t: Roof rail fasteners may be loose
items.job: Tighten or replace roof rail fasteners
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: 8-speed automatic whine and shift complaints

items.t: Engine can stall after auto stop-start
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN. A damaged cover costs more to replace.
